subject: science

concepts.title: Stages of Animal Nutrition
concepts.definition: The biological process of obtaining and utilizing nutrients, consisting of ingestion, digestion, absorption, assimilation, and egestion.
concepts.formula: nutrition_process = ingestion + digestion + absorption + assimilation + egestion
concepts.key_idea: In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, Nutrition is a multi-step sequence from food intake to waste removal.
question_patterns: what are the main steps of nutrition
list the sequence of animal nutrition
define the process of nutrition in animals
how does an animal utilize food

concepts.title: Role of Villi in Absorption
concepts.definition: Tiny, finger-like projections on the small's inner wall intestine that expand the surface area to facilitate nutrient uptake into the blood.
concepts.key_idea: Increased surface area leads to higher nutrient absorption rates.
question_patterns: what is the function of villi
how do villi help in digestion
why is the small intestine wall folded

solution_steps.explain: villi increase the base surface area by a factor
absorption is proportional to the effective surface area

concepts.title: Rumination Process
concepts.definition: A unique digestive mechanism in grass-eating animals where food is stored in the rumen, partially digested, and later returned to the mouth for thorough chewing.
concepts.key_idea: Ruminants digest tough cellulose by cycling food between the rumen and the mouth.
question_patterns: how do grass-eating animals digest cellulose

concepts.title: Amoeba Feeding Mechanism
concepts.definition: Amoeba captures microscopic prey by extending pseudopodia to engulf food into a vacuole where digestive juices break it down.
concepts.key_idea: Amoeba uses temporary false feet to trap food and internal vacuoles to digest it.
question_patterns: where does digestion occur in amoeba
describe the feeding process of amoeba

worked_examples.question_pattern: If the base surface area of the intestine is {base_area} and villi increase it by a factor of {villi_factor}, what is the effective area?
